info.title: T71- Volta de bicicleta Z2/ Z3
T74- Ultra Gravel Running Santa Cruz

training_plan.title: Threshold Session
training_plan.description:
This session supports the week's threshold focus and contributes to the current training phase.

The main work should target threshold. Complete the repetitions with consistent technique and controlled pacing, leaving enough reserve to maintain quality through the final effort.

Increase weekly volume gradually rather than through a single large session.
training_plan.objective: Develop sustainable threshold capacity. Increase sustainable training load. Develop aerobic endurance. Introduce controlled intensity. Prepare progressively for Sealand.
structure: 3×7 min at threshold (209–220 W (95–100% FTP; FTP 220 W))

training_plan.title: Easy Aerobic Session
training_plan.description:
This session supports the week's threshold focus and contributes to the current training phase.

Keep the session comfortably aerobic, using a conversational effort to develop aerobic endurance. Avoid turning the final part into an unplanned hard effort.

Increase weekly volume gradually rather than through a single large session.
training_plan.objective: Develop aerobic endurance. Increase sustainable training load. Develop aerobic endurance. Introduce controlled intensity. Prepare progressively for Sealand.

training_plan.title: Long Aerobic Session
training_plan.description:
This session supports the week's threshold focus and contributes to the current training phase.

Settle into a sustainable rhythm and use the session to develop aerobic endurance. The priority is steady execution and good energy management rather than finishing at maximal effort.

Increase weekly volume gradually rather than through a single large session.
training_plan.objective: Develop endurance and resistance to prolonged effort. Increase sustainable training load. Develop aerobic endurance. Introduce controlled intensity. Prepare progressively for Sealand.
